citation_discovery.limitations: Includes self-reference/merged editions; incomplete live index.
Duplicates/preprints and current metadata dates are not publication-priority evidence.

negative_search_limitations: A result absent from queried engines or a cited-by inventory can still exist elsewhere, under different terminology, in unindexed books, talks or private correspondence.
No inference from upload/modified/crawled/download timestamps to first worldwide public visibility.
Exact-title in-preparation manuscript was not located; nonlocation is not proof that it never circulated.
Paywalled spatial-integral final text and Physica D 133776 not fully accessed; only available preprint or discovery metadata used.
Some citation exclusions use fulltext keyword screening plus main-result checks, not line-by-line verification of every argument.
Snippets from other campaign/case papers surfaced incidentally in generic queries and were excluded from substantive analysis before freeze. Sibling priority findings were not read.
Search engine negative domain filters narrow coverage and are not assumed perfectly enforced.
